package.name: go2_robot_emulator
package.description: Makes the Gazebo Go2 look like the physical Go2 on ROS: same topic names, message types and layouts, frame ids, rates and wall-clock stamps as recorded in bag go2_all_topics_6_10_11_28, plus the front RealSense D455. Also serves the sport API (/api/sport/request -> /api/sport/response).
